deployment: existing instance with its original volumes
test_image: exact candidate digest after build and Smart1 pull
integration_wait: wait only until this container start is at least 300 seconds old
llm_summary: once at the end, from structured results
promotion: verified and latest only after all required live checks pass
after_promotion: set Quadlet to latest and daemon-reload, without another restart
rollback: restore stable, recreate the same instance, wait 300 seconds, check recovery
source_changes: prior explicit user Go for the exact diff
workflow_validation: next actual upstream upgrade; no test run during installation
